mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_key, menu_nm, page_url, api_prefix, up_menu_id, menu_level, sort_order, real_order, is_leaf, use_yn, restricted_yn, icon, link_url, new_url, path, source_type, guide_comment, content, param, manual_url, create_dt, update_dt, delete_dt, note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fd_menu WHERE delete_dt IS NULL ORDER BY real_order ASC, sort_order ASC, menu_id ASC
SELECT FROM fd_menu WHERE menu_key = #{menuKey} AND delete_dt IS NULL

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_key, m.menu_nm, m.page_url, m.api_prefix, m.up_menu_id, m.menu_level, m.sort_order, m.real_order, m.is_leaf, m.use_yn, m.restricted_yn, m.icon, m.link_url, m.new_url, m.path, m.source_type, m.guide_comment, m.content, m.param, m.manual_url, m.create_dt, m.update_dt, m.delete_dt, m.note FROM fd_menu m INNER JOIN fd_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id = m.menu_id AND a.auth_cd = #{authCd} WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.delete_dt IS NULL ORDER BY m.real_order ASC, m.sort_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fd_menu WHERE delete_dt IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fd_menu ( menu_id, menu_key, menu_nm, page_url, api_prefix, up_menu_id, menu_level, sort_order, real_order, is_leaf, use_yn, restricted_yn, icon, link_url, new_url, path, source_type, guide_comment, content, param, manual_url, create_dt, update_dt, delete_dt, note ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{menuKey}, #{menuNm}, #{pageUrl}, #{apiPrefix}, #{upMenuId}, #{menuLevel}, #{sortOrder}, #{realOrder}, #{isLeaf}, #{useYn}, #{restrictedYn}, #{icon}, #{linkUrl}, #{newUrl}, #{path}, #{sourceType}, #{guideComment}, #{content}, #{param}, #{manualUrl}, #{createDt}, #{updateDt}, #{deleteDt}, #{note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fd_menu SET menu_key = #{menuKey}, menu_nm = #{menuNm}, page_url = #{pageUrl}, api_prefix = #{apiPrefix}, up_menu_id = #{upMenuId}, menu_level = #{menuLevel}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, real_order = #{realOrder}, is_leaf = #{isLeaf}, use_yn = #{useYn}, restricted_yn = #{restrictedYn}, icon = #{icon}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, new_url = #{newUrl}, path = #{path}, source_type = #{sourceType}, guide_comment = #{guideComment}, content = #{content}, param = #{param}, manual_url = #{manualUrl}, update_dt = #{updateDt}, delete_dt = #{deleteDt}, note = #{note} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT auth_cd FROM fd_menu_auth WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY auth_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fd_menu_auth (auth_cd, menu_id, create_dt) VALUES (#{authCd}, #{menuId}, #{createDt})
